title: [In preview] Public Preview: Centralized user authentication + JWT validation for Azure Application Gateway

content: Announcing the public preview of centralized user authentication for Azure Application Gateway, along with an updated JWT validation experience. User authentication enables Application Gateway to sign users in with OpenID Connect before traffic reaches a web application. With centralized authentication policies, customers can configure authentication once and apply it consistently across routing rules and multiple Application Gateways. This approach helps simplify application architecture, reduce authentication code in backend applications, and provide a consistent sign-in experience across protected web apps. As part of this centralized policy model, Application Gateway also includes an updated JWT validation experience for scenarios such as APIs and service-to-service traffic. JWT validation helps validate bearer tokens at the gateway before requests reach backend applications, supporting a more consistent security posture across applications. The updated JWT validation experience is a revision of the existing Application Gateway JWT validation preview. The existing preview will not move forward to general availability, and Microsoft plans to deprecate it. A separate deprecation notice will be published with the deprecation date, retirement timeline, and transition guidance. This announcement is not the formal deprecation notice. Learn more: JWT validation User authentication
